# Atlas Basic plan

Atlas Basic includes 100 API requests per minute. Atlas Basic does not include priority support. The Basic plan stores data in one region.

# Atlas Pro plan

Atlas Pro includes 500 API requests per minute. Atlas Pro includes priority support. The Pro plan stores data in one region.

# API authentication

Authenticate API requests with a project-scoped bearer credential in the Authorization header. Rotate a compromised API key immediately. Revoking a key immediately prevents new requests from using it.

# Office access

Employees enter the office using a physical access badge. Lost badges should be reported to building security. Badge tokens cannot authenticate software API requests.

Atlas Basic includes 100 API requests per minute. Atlas Basic does not include priority support. The Basic plan stores data in one region.

# Atlas Pro plan

Atlas Pro includes 500 API requests per minute. Atlas Pro includes priority support. The Pro plan stores data in one region.

# API authentication

Authenticate API requests with a project-scoped bearer credential in the Authorization header. Rotate a compromised API key immediately. Revoking a key immediately prevents new requests from using it.

# Office access

Employees enter the office using a physical access badge. Lost badges should be reported to building security. Badge tokens cannot authenticate software API requests.
